name: rc11-pass1
description: RC11's six INT8 programs of model pass 1 (3x3 convolution, 16 to 16 channels, then pointwise layers; literal weights). All six: RC7's literal lowering. 0x7de1d0 (1920x1080 grid) adds RC9's binned, postscaled Winograd F(2,3) and the binned last pointwise layer (8-dot chains); it and 0x2cce40, 0x4bee10 get RC10's compiler cleanup.
